moneyCostLedger.title: Cost ledger
moneyCostLedger.sub: What the shop spent on paid services: every paid message writes a row here by itself, with the daily cost lines and return losses beside them. Nothing is paid from here.

spend.title: Spend
spend.sub: Days, months and years in the shop's own time zone

prepaid.title: Prepaid balances
prepaid.sub: Credit bought in advance (SMS credit …). Each paid message draws its cost from it, so what is left is always here.
prepaid.none: No prepaid balance yet. Record the first top-up below when you buy credit.
prepaid.badAmount: Write the amount as a number, for example 1,000.
prepaid.badCredits: Credits are a whole number, or leave it empty.
prepaid.lowHint: The page warns when the balance goes under it. Leave empty to have no low mark.
prepaid.readOnly: You can see the balances. Recording a top-up needs the "Costs" permission.

export.title: Export
export.sub: Every cost row of a period as a CSV file (amounts in poisha, times in UTC).
export.badRange: The start must not be after the end.

recent.title: Latest rows
recent.latest: The latest {n} rows, newest first. Export a period for all of them.

err.other: That did not work. Try again.
err.network: No connection. Check the internet and try again.
err.costs.INVALID_INPUT: Check the amount and try again.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
